episodes.synopsis: Emi Kaido's life changes when a band of otherworldly heroes rescue her from killer robots.
episodes.title: Isolated Flower

episodes.synopsis: Emi reluctantly uses her luxury abode to protect her motley crew of warrior heroes.
episodes.title: Immediate Family

episodes.synopsis: Having learned Damian's true identity Takeshi transforms into Polimar to thwart attacks.
episodes.title: Intelligent Fury

episodes.synopsis: Emi is dragged to a party the team is chaperoning and Jōji encounters the seductive Belle Lynn.
episodes.title: Imaginary Friend

episodes.synopsis: Suspicions grow when an elusive guest arrives at Emi's house looking for help.
episodes.title: Invisible Future

episodes.synopsis: The eccentric Damian makes an unexpected return, reminding Ken and Emi their futures are in peril.
episodes.title: Infini-T Force

episodes.synopsis: With surprise message in hand  Emi heads to a familiar place to meet a wholly unfamiliar figure. Soon  a voice from a parallel universe breaks the silence to reveal a disturbing personal story  opening the floodgates of an exchange of personal truths.
episodes.title: Insane Father

episodes.synopsis: Emi returns to life as a normal teenager, but Takeshi and Tetsuya aren't convinced.
episodes.title: Inner Frustration

episodes.synopsis: Emi and Kaan are pulled into an alternate dimension, only to find Ken and the others in a brawl.
episodes.title: In Flux

episodes.synopsis: The team has vanished  leaving Emi with a case of amnesia and another mysterious text from her father. Now  atop a Shibuya high-rise  an epic standoff with her father is about to unfold  and Emi isn't holding back.
episodes.title: Ignition Flame

episodes.synopsis: As the Case-wielding Kaido continues to eradicate worlds, the team takes collective aim.
episodes.title: Independent Flower

episodes.synopsis: The city of Shibuya again pulses with life as Emi pushes onward with her new heroic heart.
episodes.title: I'll Find...
